# Loopt

Write GitHub Actions workflows in any language. TypeScript, Python, Go, and
Rust ship as first-party languages, and custom languages plug in through the
plugin protocol. Loopt generates standard `.github/workflows/*.yml` from that
source, and can import existing workflow YAML into editable code.

Generated workflow files start with:

```text
# Generated by loopt. Edit the source under .loopt/workflows and run loopt gen.
```

Edit `.loopt/workflows/*`, not the generated YAML.

## Install

Prebuilt binaries, no Cargo required:

```sh
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/preloopdev/loopt/main/install.sh | sh
```

The script installs to `~/.local/bin` and verifies the release checksum when
one is published. Set `LOOPT_INSTALL_DIR` to change the destination, or
`LOOPT_VERSION=v0.1.1` to pin a release. Prebuilt binaries are published for
macOS arm64 and Linux x86_64.

The language you author in must be installed when generating: Node.js 26+,
Python 3, Go, or Cargo/Rust.

## Start a project

```sh
loopt init
```

Writes a starter workflow as TypeScript source in `.loopt/workflows/ci.ts`,
generates `.github/workflows/ci.yml` from it, and prints what to do next. The
starter follows your project files:

| Found | Steps |
|---|---|
| `package.json` | `npm ci` (or `npm install` without a lockfile), `npm test` |
| `Cargo.toml` | `cargo test` |
| `go.mod` | `go test ./...` |
| `pyproject.toml`, `requirements.txt`, `setup.py` | `pip install`, `python -m pytest` |
| none of these | a placeholder step to replace |

Every starter uses a read-only token (`contents: read`), pins
`actions/checkout` to a commit without persisting credentials, cancels
superseded runs, and lints clean. Edit it freely; it is only a starting point.

```sh
loopt init --language python --name build --template node
```

`--language` is `typescript` (default), `python`, `go`, or `rust`. `--name`
sets the file name (default `ci`). `--template` is `auto` (default),
`generic`, `node`, `rust`, `go`, or `python`. `init` never overwrites an
existing workflow; use `loopt import` for those.

## Use

```sh
# Import existing workflows into .loopt/workflows
loopt import --language typescript

# Generate .github/workflows from the source
loopt gen

# Fail if the committed YAML no longer matches the committed source
loopt gen --check
```

`loopt import` leaves the original YAML untouched. `loopt gen` refuses to
overwrite a workflow edited outside Loopt unless you pass `--force`.
Composite actions (`action.yml`/`action.yaml` outside `.github/workflows/`)
import as action metadata the same way.

See [Authoring workflows](docs/authoring-workflows.md) for composite-action
details, safe `run` templates, and the full source↔YAML sync semantics.

## Review

```sh
loopt lint
```

Runs native correctness and security checks on generated workflows —
optionally with [shellcheck](https://www.shellcheck.net) on `run:` scripts.
`loopt gen` runs the same review automatically.

See [Lint and security review](docs/lint-and-security.md) for the
`--persona`/`--context`/`--shellcheck` flags and severity mapping.

## Test

```sh
cargo test
```

The full external-fixture corpus test is opt-in:

```sh
PRELOOP_FIXTURES=/path/to/fixtures cargo test --test corpus -- --ignored
```
